items.prompt: A kitchen dissolving into another place like a projector slide changing mid-click: half of the frame is a plain dacha kitchen with a cup of tea, the other half is an unfamiliar city flat with beige walls and a window onto apartment blocks, the two images overlapping along a soft seam.

alt.ru: Кухня, сменяющаяся другим местом, как слайд в проекторе: половина кадра — кухня дачи с чашкой чая, другая — чужая городская квартира с бежевыми стенами, изображения сливаются по мягкому шву.
alt.en: A kitchen changing into another place like a projector slide: half the frame a dacha kitchen with a cup of tea, half an unfamiliar city flat with beige walls, overlapping along a soft seam.
alt.pt: Uma cozinha a transformar-se noutro lugar como um diapositivo: metade da imagem a cozinha da dacha com uma chávena, metade um apartamento estranho de paredes bege, sobrepostos.
alt.es: Una cocina convirtiéndose en otro lugar como una diapositiva: mitad del encuadre la cocina de la dacha con una taza, mitad un piso desconocido de paredes beige, superpuestos.
